instructions: My Profile / Account FAQ only (entrepreneur TEFConnect My Profile). Other profiles are separate modules. Follow the common rule book for shared assistant behaviour.

faqs.question: What is My Profile on TEFConnect?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneur TEFConnect account personal information: Personal Information, Next of Kin, Contact & Education, Social Media. Not Marketplace/Alumni/Mentorship profiles.

faqs.question: Why am I forced to complete My Profile?
faqs.answer: Incomplete TEFConnect profile redirects you here before most programme areas. Dashboard: Kindly complete your profile before starting any Programmes.

faqs.question: How do I edit My Profile?
faqs.answer: My Profile → Edit or Complete Personal Information → update sections → Update Profile. Cancel discards unsaved edits.

faqs.question: What sections are on My Profile?
faqs.answer: Personal Information; Provide Details of Your Next of Kin; Contact & Education Details; Social Media Profile ID Details.

faqs.question: What is required in Personal Information?
faqs.answer: Title (Mr/Mrs/Miss/Dr), Surname, First Name, DOB (18+), Gender (Male/Female), Preferred Language, Email (display only), medical None/Yes (+ disability name if Yes), ID card, passport photo. Match government ID.

faqs.question: ID and passport upload rules?
faqs.answer: JPG/PNG/JPEG/PDF only; each under 5 MB. Valid govt ID and clear passport-size photo.

faqs.question: Next of kin required fields?
faqs.answer: Name, Phone, Relationship, Email — all required.

faqs.question: Contact & education required fields?
faqs.answer: Home Address, Country of Origin, State/Province/Region, Mobile Number, Highest Level of Education (+ Other specify). City/Town and Major Area optional if blank.

faqs.question: Are all social fields required?
faqs.answer: At least one valid http/https URL among Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram.

faqs.question: Why can’t I change name/DOB/ID?
faqs.answer: After approval/verification, Surname, First Name, DOB, Gender, and ID card can freeze. Email always frozen. Passport photo can still be replaced. Other/Middle Name stays editable.

faqs.question: Where is Access Marketplace on My Profile?
faqs.answer: Shown while TEF profile is incomplete. After completion, use side menu Access Marketplace. It enrols Marketplace from TEF session.

faqs.question: After successful profile update?
faqs.answer: If complete: Profile Updated success → Ok → Dashboard. If still incomplete: success toast and preview to finish remaining fields.

faqs.question: Same as Marketplace/Alumni profile?
faqs.answer: No. Separate Mentorship, Marketplace, and Alumni Community profiles exist.

faqs.question: What can I not do on My Profile?
faqs.answer: Cannot change email, manage password/security here, upload CV (mentor), manage Marketplace/Alumni feed settings, or select Gender Other.

faqs.question: Profile help?
faqs.answer: Profile FAQ's from Need Help when shown.

faqs.question: Title options?
faqs.answer: Mr, Mrs, Miss, Dr.

faqs.question: Minimum age?
faqs.answer: 18 years old.

faqs.question: Email editable?
faqs.answer: No. Email is always frozen on My Profile.

faqs.question: Medical conditions field.
faqs.answer: None or Yes; if Yes, disability name is required.

faqs.question: Invalid file type.
faqs.answer: Use JPG, PNG, or PDF only.

faqs.question: File larger than 5 MB.
faqs.answer: File size must be less than 5 MB.

faqs.question: Education Other.
faqs.answer: Choose Other then specify other highest level of education.

faqs.question: Changing country.
faqs.answer: Clears state/province in edit mode — select region again.

faqs.question: Access General Training on My Profile.
faqs.answer: Shown with Access Marketplace while TEF profile incomplete; opens Training link in a new tab.

faqs.question: Complete Personal Information vs Edit.
faqs.answer: Incomplete profiles show Complete Personal Information; completed profiles show Edit.

faqs.question: Can I still change passport photo after approval?
faqs.answer: Yes. Passport photo can still be replaced when other fields are frozen.

faqs.question: Social URL format.
faqs.answer: Valid http/https URLs.

faqs.question: Name length rules.
faqs.answer: Surname/first/middle(if filled): 2–50 letters and spaces.

faqs.question: Email length rules.
faqs.answer: 5–100 characters with valid structure.

faqs.question: Password change on My Profile?
faqs.answer: Not on this page — use Registration/Login password flows where available.

faqs.question: CV upload on My Profile?
faqs.answer: No. CV belongs on Mentorship profile for mentors.

faqs.question: Mentor where is profile?
faqs.answer: Mentorship profile — see Mentorship document.

faqs.question: Dashboard banner about profile.
faqs.answer: Kindly complete your profile before starting any Programmes → Complete your profile.

faqs.question: Cancel while editing.
faqs.answer: Exits edit and restores saved data; clears temp uploads.

faqs.question: Other/Middle Name required?
faqs.answer: No, optional.

faqs.question: City/Town required?
faqs.answer: Optional in the form; validated if filled (max 100).

faqs.question: Major Area of Study required?
faqs.answer: Optional; validated if filled (max 100).

faqs.question: What education levels exist?
faqs.answer: No Formal Education through Doctorate Degree options plus Other, including diploma/bachelor/master/PhD equivalents listed on the form.

faqs.question: Access Marketplace disappeared after I completed profile.
faqs.answer: Those My Profile header buttons show while incomplete; use side menu afterward.

faqs.question: Gender frozen.
faqs.answer: Gender may freeze after approval along with name/DOB/ID.

faqs.question: No FAQs available.
faqs.answer: Shown when Profile FAQ list is empty.

faqs.question: Is My Profile a social profile?
faqs.answer: No. It is TEFConnect account personal information, not a feed/connections profile.

faqs.question: Enter details as on government ID.
faqs.answer: Please enter the details exactly as they appear on your government-issued ID.

faqs.question: ID card hint.
faqs.answer: Upload valid govt approved ID card / less than 5 MB.

faqs.question: Passport hint.
faqs.answer: Upload a clear passport photo of you / less than 5 MB.
